hypotheses.H_d: SP8 (the SC7 certification rule with the ALIGNED lookahead LU-C) closes the G6b gap: pooled in_family_original_2x2 dual coverage SP8 - A2 >= -0.03 with 95% CI lower bound >= -0.05. Rationale (Inferred): SC7 certifies a single-support code in calm steps without Y1k ("tracked-calm") but chooses actions with LU-R, which counts only Y1k-certifiable branches; LU-C counts exactly what the SC7 rule would certify at t+1 (calm: single support + margin agreement as A2/LU; not calm: LU-R), so the action policy and the certification rule are aligned. Prediction: Open / borderline (smoke -0.016, n=20, Observed; study-009 SC7 -0.050).
hypotheses.H_c: (diagnostic, gated as GD) Stale post-drift false certificates are a MODEL-CLASS violation, not a late alarm: after a silent jump at step d (an observation at d that is masked or unsurprising, so no event can fire at d), the no-jump region excludes the true (machine, path) and the surviving hypotheses agree on a wrong code at d+1; the jump is information-theoretically undetectable before the forecast for d+1 is issued. Testable prediction: >= 0.8 of the non-drift false certificates of SC7 and SP8 (pooled, taken and counterfactual) on held-out drift4 are at step d+1 for a drift step d with NO event at d.
hypotheses.H_j: (price of silent-jump safety) J8 = S7 certification AND the jump-hull union Y1kJ == {c} (brute/jumphull.py: the region with the last transition x[T-1] -> x[T] removed, so the hidden state may have jumped to any state before observation T). Exact by construction (to be unit-tested): Y1k is a subset of Y1kJ, and if the true machine is within the bound and the ONLY violation of the stationary model is one jump just before the last observation, the true next code is in Y1kJ. Inferred consequence: while fewer states are visited than the bound, a jump into a fresh state is consistent and Y1kJ is all codes, so J8 certifies almost nothing. Prediction: J8 passes G3-prime (0 non-drift false) and FAILS G6b with pooled coverage <= 0.02 (Observed 0.000 on 12 smoke cases).
hypotheses.H_a: (harness) Every held-out stream finishes within the 2 h cap under an independent watchdog; a smoke kill drill shows watchdog kill latency <= 15 s.
hypotheses.H_b: (verification) The second implementation (enumeration rows, no brute import) re-derives every field of J8, SP8, SC7 on a pre-registered mandatory sample and BSC7, BSP8 on a breadth sample with 0 mismatches inside its budget; the symmetric incremental CaDiCaL harness re-derives B5 and BSC7 on all breadth cases; a bounded no-symmetry spot check (prefix of 24 steps) completes.

event_triggers.E1: v0.6.0 event, unchanged: after observing step u, residual (mean of the last W=8 surprises, 12 d.p.) > tau x 0.5, or a window-tier event (as brute/driftsound._note_event)
event_triggers.E2: falsified certificate: the forecast for the taken action at step u carried a conditional certificate c and the observation at u is incompatible with c (bit c not in the observation mask). Constant-free.
event_triggers.E3: single-step surprise: s_u = -ln compatible_mass(published probabilities for u, observation u) > tau (tau6 for 2x2, tau7 for breadth; the frozen ALARM threshold applied to one step instead of the window mean). No new constant. Exact: tau6 = 1.645215 > ln 4 = 1.386294 and tau7 = 2.07944154168 > ln 8 = 2.07944154167984 (margin ~2e-13), so a forecast spread uniformly over all codes never triggers E3; E3 needs the realised observation to have had probability < e^-tau (0.1930 for 2x2, 0.1250 for 8 codes).
event_triggers.note: Inferred: when the published forecast is a certified one, E2 implies E3 (the falsified code carried >= 1-3eps/4 mass, so the compatible mass is <= 3 x eps/4 = 0.015, s >= 4.2 > tau6); E2 is kept as an explicit, constant-free trigger and each event records which triggers fired. Alarms (F4 RESIDUAL_SURPRISE), resume, probabilities and LU-R are NOT changed by E2/E3.

Y1kJ is the Y1k formula on JumpRegionK: RegionK (same variables, symmetry and bound) with the transition constraint into the LAST observation removed and that transition not counted as a traversal (Tr ranges over t < T-1). arms.SP8: brute.align.AlignedSyncLearner: the frozen SyncEventLearner(rule="CTR") (SC7 certification unchanged) with the action policy LU-C: for each action a and each code c in the support, N(a,c) = number of actions b such that, after the hypothetical full observation (a,c): family support for b is a single code s, the extended region is feasible and not saturated, the margin support for b equals s, and EITHER step t+1 is calm (no event u with (t+1) - u < W, and t+1 >= burn_in; the condition under which SC7 would certify s via "tracked-calm") OR Y1k of the extended region for b with mask {c} equals s (the LU-R condition). Score(a) = mean over c of N(a,c); ties -> passive action (as LU-R). Any solver budget hit -> 0 for that branch (as LU-R).

stop_rule.cap: 2 h 00 min (7200 s) wall clock from RUN_T0 (the epoch written with the run_start_010 ledger entry); smoke, seed check, diagnostic replay and plan steps are outside the cap
stop_rule.streams_and_budgets: 2x2 (J8, SP8, SC7, A4, A2) 3 workers 1500 s; breadth (B5, BSC7, BSP8) 3 workers 2400 s; gti 2 workers 2400 s (starts at t0); g11_2x2 2 workers 1500 s (after 2x2); repro_2x2 2 workers 900 s (after 2x2); gx2_sym 2 workers 1200 s (after breadth); gx2_spot 1 worker 1200 s (after breadth); g11_breadth 2 workers 1500 s (after breadth); repro_breadth 2 workers 1500 s (after breadth); at most 8 worker processes at once (the watchdog and orchestrator are not counted)
stop_rule.projection: at RUN_T0 + 360 s (5% of the cap) the orchestrator writes PROGRESS_010.json: cases done per stream, rate, projected finish of 2x2 and breadth; the operator reads it. Pre-registered cut: if the projected breadth finish exceeds RUN_T0 + 3600 s, the operator stops nothing and changes nothing (stream budgets already bound every stream); the projection is reported. No design, seed or threshold change follows from it.
stop_rule.watchdog: scripts/watchdog_010.py is started by the operator (nohup, own session) right after RUN_T0 is written; it writes HEARTBEAT_010.jsonl every 2 s and at RUN_T0 + 7200 s sends SIGTERM to the orchestrator and to every stream process group listed in RUN_STATE_010.json, then SIGKILL after 20 s, writes STOP_010.json with the kill wall time and latency; the orchestrator also enforces the cap itself
stop_rule.at_cap: every unfinished stream is stopped; its checkpoint is sealed as it is (outside the cap, by the operator, with the frozen seal tools; sealing does not add evidence); ledger stop_010; NO extension and NO rerun
stop_rule.scoring: every gate whose inputs are incomplete at the cap or whose stream completed after RUN_T0 + 7200 s (wall time recorded by the orchestrator or, if absent, the output file mtime) is FAIL (reason STUDY_BUDGET); G_RT is then FAIL

what_counts_as_failure: any gated criterion not meeting its threshold is FAIL and is published as FAIL in GATES_010.json, README, CHANGELOG, RELEASE.json and the release notes with the same wording
GA1_010 FAIL means the drift-and-coverage target is NOT met even if G3-prime and G6b are each passed by a DIFFERENT arm
a smoke or seen-data observation never softens a FAIL
any gate with inputs incomplete at the cap, or completed after it, is FAIL (stop_rule)
a missing run_start ledger entry, a seed outside its declared range, a frozen-file hash mismatch, or a smoke run on a non-smoke seed invalidates the affected run (reported, not silently rerun)

no re-run, re-seed, threshold change or rule-constant change after the held-out run_start; reruns only for an infrastructure crash with identical code and seeds, ledgered as deviation and still inside the cap
